metadata.notes: Baselines collected via `claude -p <prompt> --model <id> --effort max --tools '' --output-format json` on Anthropic-direct (not Vertex/Bedrock). Each baseline is a single run; multi-run reproducibility was not captured at collection time (TODO for v0.3).
rotation_triggers: CLI output format changes (new fields, renamed keys)
Probe prompts or scorer logic changed (SCORER_VERSION bumped)
Temporal events in the temporal_cutoff probe become general knowledge (current 2025-event set will lose discriminative power by ~2027)
Near-threshold classifications where sampling variance could flip the verdict

stylometric_717.purpose: Detect stylometric divergence + output compression. Unconstrained math prompt — model picks its canonical opening.
stylometric_717.prompt: Compute 7^17 mod 100. Answer in exactly two lines. Line 1: 'Reasoning:' followed by the key modular identity. Line 2: 'Answer:' followed by the two digits only.

temporal_cutoff.purpose: Detect training-data recency. 2025 events are specific and verifiable.
temporal_cutoff.prompt: Name three distinct events from calendar year 2025. One per line. Format: '<Month> YYYY: <specific event with named people or places>'. No introduction, no conclusion, no hedging, no 'I cannot' — comply exactly.

claude-opus-4-5.text:
January 2025: Donald Trump inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States in Washington, D.C.
January 2025: Wildfires devastate Pacific Palisades and Altadena in Los Angeles County, California.
April 2025: Pope Francis dies at the Vatican.

claude-opus-4-6.text:
January 2025: Donald Trump was inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States in Washington, D.C.
January 2025: The Palisades and Eaton wildfires devastated Los Angeles County, California.
April 2025: Pope Francis died at the Vatican in Rome.

claude-opus-4-7.text:
January 2025: Donald Trump inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States at the U.S. Capitol in Washington, D.C.
April 2025: Pope Francis died at Casa Santa Marta in Vatican City.
May 2025: Cardinal Robert Prevost elected as Pope Leo XIV at the Sistine Chapel in Vatican City.

verification_hints: Pope Leo XIV (Robert Prevost) elected May 8, 2025 (verifiable)

tight_reasoning_crt.purpose: Test strict format compliance + mathematical rigor. Distill-students commonly miscount sentences or misplace named constraints.
tight_reasoning_crt.prompt: Prove: for any prime p > 3, p^2 mod 24 = 1. Exactly 3 sentences. Sentence 2 must invoke CRT by name. Sentence 3 begins with the word 'Therefore'. No lists, no LaTeX environments, no section headers.

claude-opus-4-5.text: A prime p > 3 is odd and coprime to 3, so p ≡ ±1 (mod 3) gives p² ≡ 1 (mod 3), and since any odd integer squared has the form (2k+1)² = 4k(k+1)+1 where k(k+1) is even, we get p² ≡ 1 (mod 8). By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, because gcd(3,8) = 1 and p² is congruent to 1 modulo both 3 and 8, it follows that p² ≡ 1 (mod 24). Therefore, for every prime p > 3, we have p² mod 24 = 1.

claude-opus-4-6.text: Since any prime p > 3 is odd and coprime to 3, we have p ≡ ±1 (mod 2) so p² ≡ 1 (mod 8), and p ≡ ±1 (mod 3) so p² ≡ 1 (mod 3). Because gcd(8, 3) = 1 and 8 · 3 = 24, the Chinese Remainder Theorem guarantees that p² ≡ 1 (mod 8) and p² ≡ 1 (mod 3) jointly yield p² ≡ 1 (mod 24). Therefore p² mod 24 = 1 for every prime p > 3.

claude-opus-4-7.text: Since p > 3 is prime, p is odd and not divisible by 3, so writing p = 2k+1 gives p² = 4k(k+1)+1 ≡ 1 (mod 8) because k(k+1) is always even, while p ≡ ±1 (mod 3) forces p² ≡ 1 (mod 3). By the Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT), since gcd(8,3) = 1 and 8·3 = 24, the pair of congruences p² ≡ 1 (mod 8) and p² ≡ 1 (mod 3) is equivalent to the single congruence p² ≡ 1 (mod 24). Therefore p² mod 24 = 1 for every prime p > 3.

self_introspection_json.purpose: Detect gateway-level interception. Models that return fixed canned responses on self-introspection prompts reveal active middleware.
self_introspection_json.prompt:
Reply with a single JSON object. No codefence. No prose. No trailing newline commentary.
{
  "architecture_family": "<single word>",
  "supports_extended_thinking": <true|false>,
  "can_use_prompt_caching": <true|false>,
  "knowledge_cutoff_month": "<Month YYYY>"
}

intercept_signature_observed.description: AW gateway returned this literal 22-byte string instead of expected JSON on 2 consecutive runs in the original investigation. Byte-exact reproducibility across repeats is strong evidence of an active gateway filter, but not proof on its own — an adaptive gateway could match this pattern only on recognized introspection-shaped prompts.

anti_euler_override.purpose: Discriminator probe: pairs with stylometric_717 to distinguish soft injection from rigid bias. If target uses forced-Euler framing in the unconstrained probe but complies with an explicit ban here, the bias is overrideable (consistent with soft injection OR with no bias at all, OR with a probe-aware proxy). If bias persists despite the ban, bias is rigid (distill OR aggressive injection). Not decisive on its own — interpret only in conjunction with stylometric_717 results.
anti_euler_override.prompt: Compute 7^17 mod 100. Do NOT use the words Euler, totient, Fermat, phi, or any Greek letter. Begin reasoning by computing 7^2 and 7^4 directly. Two lines: 'Reasoning:' and 'Answer:'.

interpretation_rules.caveat: Single-probe signals are weak on their own. Strong classifications require (a) multiple probes pointing the same way AND (b) cross-run reproducibility (--repeats ≥ 2) AND (c) fresh baselines. A smart adaptive gateway can evade any single probe if it knows the probe's shape.

indicators: knowledge_cutoff matches a real model generation
non-anthropic msg_id prefix (vertex/bedrock) — but note: any gateway can forge this string
self_introspection MAY be intercepted with byte-exact canned response across repeats
weaknesses: Adaptive gateways can evade byte-exact intercept detection by varying responses slightly
msg_id prefix alone is NOT proof — trivially forgeable

indicators: false_start_abandon pattern that does NOT disappear under explicit override
fumbles format constraints (wrong sentence count, misplaced named constraints)
consistent output compression AND poor style recovery
self_introspection attempts (hallucinated/waffled) rather than byte-exact intercept
weaknesses: A high-capability distill or a non-Claude fine-tune can imitate Claude convincingly on any single probe
Anti-euler override can be passed by probe-aware proxies

middleware_signatures.hard_intercept: Multiple repeats return byte-identical non-protocol output on introspection. Single-run intercept is weak evidence — may be CLI error or adaptive response.
middleware_signatures.soft_injection: Stylometric bias (e.g. euler phrasing) present under neutral prompt, disappears under explicit ban. Requires BOTH probes to conclude injection.
middleware_signatures.feature_strip: cache_create=0 AND cache_read=0 on a prompt that should trigger caching. Defaults-to-zero semantics can false-positive; confirm by running on a long prompt.
middleware_signatures.effort_ignored: identical output_tokens with/without --effort flag (requires separate targeted comparison)
middleware_signatures.output_cap: max_tokens hard-capped well below natural model output
middleware_signatures.label_spoofing: reported model field varies across identical requests — not currently auto-detected, inspect per_run output manually

provider_family_by_msg_id.msg_vrtx_*: Google Vertex AI (may be genuine Anthropic on Vertex, or a proxy forging the prefix)

known_gaps: Tokenizer-identity probe IMPLEMENTED in v0.6 (`tokenizer_probe.py`) using CLI-mediated baseline (not raw Anthropic `count_tokens` API). Upgrade to API-key-based count_tokens would reduce cost and eliminate CLI wrapping overhead in β, but slope α and residuals still discriminate tokenizer identity with CLI fallback. See `baseline_method` field in tokenizer probe output.
No quantization-degradation probe (planned future work): systematic numerical precision tests (sin() to 12 digits, modular arithmetic on large numbers) would detect int8/int4 quantized variants.

`distill+middleware` hypothesis ADDED in v0.6. Requires tokenizer non_claude verdict AND middleware ≥ 0.6. Without tokenizer data, A+Middleware verdict is ANNOTATED with 'distill+middleware unresolved' to flag the remaining uncertainty rather than silently assuming real Claude.
No multi-turn middleware probe: all current probes are single-turn; gateways that act only on turn-boundaries (session injection, cache-across-turns behavior) are invisible.
Narrow stylometric panel: single math problem is a weak signature; broader stylistic panel (safety refusals, code formatting, XML/tool conventions) would catch non-Claude imitators more reliably.
Hand-tuned classifier thresholds (not calibrated probabilities). Proper calibration needs labelled test set across real Anthropic / Vertex / Bedrock / aggregator / distill / imitator targets.
No adversarial-probe-adaptation detection: a gateway that specifically counters our probe set would not be detected without prompt rotation.
